name: Score Components
old_description: OVERCOME YOUR BIGGEST ELECTRONIC COMPONENT SUPPLY CHAIN CHALLENGES
about:
Score Components is based in Beverly, Massachusetts, where it operates as an independent distributor of electronic components and supply-chain solutions. The company serves manufacturers and their electronics manufacturing services (EMS) partners worldwide, leveraging a global network of strategic manufacturer alliances.

The firm provides a broad suite of value-added services that include RoHS analysis and verification testing, custom repackaging and relabeling, solderability testing, programming and blanking, lead inspection, trimming and forming, bake and dry pack to JEDEC J-STD-033, tape and reeling, climate-controlled extended storage, and shipment consolidation. It also offers excess and obsolete material disposition, shortage and hard-to-find sourcing, inventory management programs, and a proprietary Parts List Merger (PLM) tool for cost‑savings analysis.

Score Components supports customers across data center and enterprise computing, automotive and transportation, industrial automation, telecommunications and networking, aerospace and defense, energy, consumer electronics, and gaming and PC sectors. Its client base includes OEMs, EMS providers, and other distributors seeking to reduce procurement costs, manage inventory, and bridge supply gaps.

The company emphasizes superior service, exceptional quality with factory‑sealed parts, and a culture of respectful values and fair principles that it describes as 'Boston Strong.' Its quality control personnel double‑check every order for accuracy, and the team collaborates closely with clients to deliver timely, cost‑effective solutions.
